text.p: Arden Industrial Products Inc said Wednesday it has received an unsolicited offer from Park-Ohio Industries Inc to acquire Arden in a merger transaction for $6 a share in cash.
Based on Arden's seven million shares outstanding, the total offer is valued at $42 million.
Arden said its board of directors has not had an opportunity to consider the offer but will do so promptly.

Arden is a national distributor of specialty and standard fasteners to the industrial market. The company had reported a loss of $883,000 for its fiscal second quarter ended December 31, 1996. At that time, the company said it was taking actions to identify and address some inventory problems.

Cleveland, Ohio-based Park-Ohio makes forged and machined products, containers and induction heating systems. The company recently reported 1997 first quarter earnings of $2.2 million on sales of $93.8 million.
Shares of Arden were trading off 3/16 to 4-1/16 following a trading halt. Shares of Park-Ohio were trading up 1/4 to 12-1/4.
